name: @thunderclap-engine/template-platformer
description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer on @thunderclap-engine/engine: a tile map from a string level format, a flipbook player with coyote time and jump buffering, one-way and moving platforms, parallax, a look-ahead camera, a HUD, a pad-walkable pause menu, synthesised sounds and a versioned save. The game-specific code is levels/.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
